title: How to Apply Coupon Codes or Price Overrides in the Admin When Manually Creating an Order | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Apply Coupon Codes or Price Overrides in the Admin When Manually Creating an Order Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097731 When manually creating an order in the Admin Area, there is no need to apply a coupon code. Instead, the order price can be adjusted directly, allowing any discount or price override to be entered manually. Creating a Manual Order with a Custom Price Log in to the Admin Area. Navigate to My Members → Search Members . Locate the member and click Actions → Payment History . Click New Order in the upper-right corner. Select the appropriate Membership Plan and Billing Cycle . Enter the desired price for the order. This value overrides the default price for the selected membership plan, making a coupon code unnecessary. Complete the remaining order details as needed. Click Save Changes to create the order. This approach can be used whenever a discounted price or one-time price adjustment needs to be applied to a manually created order.
